label: Atkinson & Boore (2003)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, interface and intraslab) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Atkinson & Boore (2003)

site.anchor_note: Resolved from the site terms c5 (class C), c6 (class D) and c7 (class E); class B / hard rock is the reference.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for both event types. PGA coefficients (c1-c4 per event type, c5-c7 site terms, geometric-spreading expressions, regional c1 revisions and both sigma components) are now available.

implementation_notes: Test both event types, near and far distances, and all site branches.
Region variables, if used by the original equation, must be exposed explicitly.

regional_variants.note: The appendix gives revised c1 values by region.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 11* km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 550* km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.approximate: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): values starred
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code C (randomly chosen component); OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/atkinson_boore_2003.py declares IMC.RANDOM_HORIZONTAL (p. 1706)
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/atkinson_boore_2003.py (SSLAB) coefficient table; period count and range (7 periods, 0.04-3 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. The OpenQuake interface table adds a 4.0 s row that the code rescales by 1/0.550; it is an implementation extension and is excluded.
